#!/bin/bash

# env_setup.sh - Environment setup script
# This script sets up the basic environment configuration

echo "Setting up environment..."

# Create necessary directories
mkdir -p logs configs data

# Set up basic configuration
if [ ! -f "configs/app.conf" ]; then
    echo "Creating default config file..."
    mkdir -p configs
    cat > configs/app.conf << 'EOL'
# Default application configuration
DEBUG=true
LOG_LEVEL=info
PORT=3000
EOL
    echo "Configuration file created at configs/app.conf"
fi

# Create a basic log file
touch logs/app.log

# Display completion message
echo "Environment setup complete!"
echo "Created directories: logs, configs, data"
echo "Created files: configs/app.conf, logs/app.log"

# Make the script executable
chmod +x env_setup.sh

# Instructions
echo "To use this environment, source this script: source env_setup.sh"
